# 10times

> > 10times is a global business event discovery platform connecting professionals with trade shows, conferences, exhibitions, and industry events worldwide.

The platform aggregates thousands of events across industries and geographies, helping businesses discover networking opportunities, industry exhibitions, and professional conferences. Users can browse events by category, location, and industry sector to find relevant business opportunities globally.

## Key Topics

- Trade shows and exhibitions
- Business conferences
- Global event directory
- Industry-specific events
- Event discovery platform
- Auto service exhibitions (China)
- Technology summits (AIBoomi)
- Trade expos (GCCI)
- Manufacturing exhibitions (Die & Mould India)
- African trade fairs (AFROZUM)
- Preschool and education events
- International business networking
- Event venues and locations

## Main Platform

- [10times Homepage](https://10times.com/): Main hub for discovering global trade shows, conferences, exhibitions, seminars, workshops, and business events across all industries and locations
